# Bijay Subedi

> Bijay Subedi is a senior software engineer in Kathmandu, Nepal, with 5+ years of experience building Ruby on Rails, React, and AWS applications. Bijay works at Truemark (https://www.truemark.dev/) building workflow and automation platforms for US clients, mainly in healthcare localization and e-commerce.

## Profile

- Role: Senior Software Engineer, Truemark (Aug 2022 – present); Associate Software Engineer, Truemark (Apr 2021 – Aug 2022)
- Core stack: Ruby on Rails 7, React 18, Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus), PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, ActionCable, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), Docker, RSpec, Jest
- Highlights: led 6+ client Rails applications; migrated a monolith to AWS microservices (40% lower inter-service latency); APIs serving 500K+ requests/month at 99.9% uptime; PostgreSQL query times cut by up to 60%; deploys cut from ~45 min to under 8 min; mentored 3 junior engineers
- Availability: open to senior full-time remote roles; Kathmandu (UTC+5:45); 4+ hours overlap with US Eastern, full EU workday overlap
- Contact: sharma.bj11@gmail.com

## Projects (case studies)

- [Helios]({{SITE_URL}}/projects/helios/): a workflow platform that runs medical translation projects end to end (intake, file routing, pricing, vendor work orders, delivery, invoicing) for a US healthcare localization provider (client under NDA). Rails 7, React, Sidekiq, ActionCable, AWS S3, Pundit.
- [Quoting]({{SITE_URL}}/projects/quoting/): a quote-management platform that turns healthcare translation requests into accurate, versioned quotes using worksheet rules, file lists, and word counts. Rails 7, React 18, PostgreSQL, ActionCable, AWS S3, Pundit.
- [AListEngine]({{SITE_URL}}/projects/alistengine/): an AI tool that turns product photos into ready-to-publish listings (title, description, price) and exports them to Shopify, AuctionFlex, and LiveAuctioneers. Cut listing creation from hours to minutes. Rails, React, AI vision and text generation.
